scripts.lib.js: shared helpers; seeds Math.random; injects read-only instrumentation into the HTML response in flight (guide files untouched)
scripts.indep.js: independently typed reference data (IUPAC atomic weights, R, CRC water vapor pressure, textbook van der Waals a/b, critical temperatures, ΔHf, specific heats, ΔHsoln, solubilities)
scripts.gen-gases.js -> gases-generators.json: 2,000 problems per generator, recomputed from question text; displayed answer and correctly rounded answer graded; slips inside tolerance; slip-message firing
scripts.ui-gases.js -> gases-ui.json: 2,000 questions per section through the real check() with typed displayed answers, hints/setups, slip spot checks
scripts.models-gases.js -> gases-models.json: explorer readouts vs the laws (Boyle, Charles, Gay-Lussac, Avogadro, combined, PV=nRT, density chart, unknown gas, Dalton, air, over water, stoichiometry, urms, Graham, Z, van der Waals)
scripts.why-gases.js -> gases-why.json: worked explanation contains the displayed answer (74,000 numeric problems)
scripts.calor-solve.js: independent solver for calorimetry questions + guided-blank values
scripts.gen-calor.js -> calor-generators.json: 52,134 generated problems recomputed; ΔH data vs ΔHf; Hess by independent linear solve
scripts.ui-calor.js -> calor-ui.json: 8,400 problems through the UI at Guided setup / Hints if I ask / On my own, plus 2,100 Hess problems arranged with the buttons
scripts.slips-calor.js -> calor-slips.json: 120,116 slip values typed as a student would round them; worked-solution q vs guided blank
scripts.lab-calor.js -> calor-lab.json: 6,000 simulated calorimeter runs with energy bookkeeping and independent grading; 6 UI runs with a fast clock

faults.section: 9 Gas stoichiometry (g2L, L2g), 7 Density (dQ, mFromD), and their copies in 12
faults.issue: The 22.41 L/mol shortcut away from STP is a named slip with its own message, but numQ drops that message when it falls within 1.3 x tolerance, and the 2% tolerance then marks the slip correct
faults.rate: g2L 7.2%, L2g 10.3%, dQ 3.5%, mFromD 2.9% of draws
faults.example: CO2 from 14.8 g CaCO3 at 28 °C and 1.10 atm: answer 3.32 L; 0.1479 mol x 22.41 = 3.31 L is accepted
faults.code: numQ: if(!isFinite(t[0]) || Math.abs(t[0] - o.a) <= 1.3 * tol) return;  with g2L T = gT(15, 40), P = g3(rint(90, 130)/100)
faults.fix: redraw T,P until |RT/P - 22.41| > 3% (as the van der Waals generator does with its 3% guard), or use rel 0.01 for these types

faults.issue: Other slips land inside the 2% window by coincidence
faults.rate: toSTP upside-down pressure ratio 14.4% (P1 within ~1% of 760 torr); fromX 'multiplied by moles' 4.6% (total moles near 1); bMixed 1.6%; iN 0.6%
faults.example: 442 mL at 755 torr and 15 °C to STP: answer 416 mL; upside-down ratio gives 422 mL, accepted
faults.fix: redraw when a listed slip is within tolerance (P1 not within 15 torr of 760; n1+n2 not within 0.04 of 1)

faults.code: check(): Q.traps.find(tr => Math.abs(v - tr[0]) <= Math.max(1e-9, Math.abs(tr[0]) * 0.011))

calorimetryFaults.section: 1 Heat and temperature (m, c, dT, Tf types)
calorimetryFaults.issue: worked solution prints q to whole joules; for heats under 100 J given with a decimal the printed q differs from the given q, its arithmetic line does not reproduce the answer, and typing the printed q into the guided q blank is marked wrong (1% tolerance)
calorimetryFaults.example: 16.2 g unknown metal releases 24.7 J, 75.8 -> 64.0 °C: solution shows q = −25 J and c = −25 J ÷ (16.2 g × −11.8 °C) = 0.129 (−25 gives 0.131)
calorimetryFaults.code: makeHeat: 'Heat in joules. q = '+fx(qJ,0)+' J' (three places) and gcell(...,fx(qJ,0),...)
calorimetryFaults.fix: print the given value: sig(qJ,3) or the qS text with its sign

calorimetryFaults.issue: the 'use the total mass (water + solid)' slip changes Tf by less than the 0.15 °C tolerance, so it is accepted and its message never shows
calorimetryFaults.example: 2.37 g KOH in 150.0 g water at 23.67 °C, ΔH = −57.6 kJ/mol: answer 27.49 °C; water-only mass gives 27.55 °C, accepted
calorimetryFaults.code: makeCoffee predict: tolAbs:0.15 and clean(..., ans, 0.3)
calorimetryFaults.fix: redraw until |slip − ans| ≥ 0.3 °C, or drop this slip from the predict type

calorimetryFaults.issue: slip values near 0 °C typed to 1 decimal miss the 1% match window
calorimetryFaults.example: 98.0 g granite at 16.6 °C absorbs 1.63 kJ: the sign slip −4.45 typed as −4.5 shows the generic hint, not 'The sample absorbed heat, so its temperature goes up'
calorimetryFaults.code: gradePart: Math.abs(v-e.value)<=Math.max(0.01*Math.abs(e.value), part.errAbs||0) (temperature parts set no errAbs; Hess sets 0.15)
calorimetryFaults.fix: add errAbs:0.15 to the Tf parts

calorimetryFaults.issue: KNO3 amounts above its solubility at the final temperature
calorimetryFaults.example: 11.3 g KNO3 in 50.0 g water, 19.22 -> 4.01 °C (22.6 g/100 g vs about 16 g/100 g at 4 °C)
calorimetryFaults.fix: cap the KNO3 mass/water ratio or redraw when the final temperature is below the saturation temperature

calorimetryFaults.issue: procedure says weigh out between 2 and 10 g, but the scoop button stays until the mass reaches 10 g and each scoop adds 0.9-2.2 g, so up to 12.2 g
calorimetryFaults.fix: hide the button when ms + 2.2 > 10, or clamp the scoop
